title: FN-Prune: Training-Free Expert Pruning with Finite RMSNorm Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2611.31747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expert pruning reduces the memory footprint of mixture-of-experts language models, but retaining model quality depends on which experts are removed. Frequency- and magnitude-based scores measure the expert in isolation and overlook how normalization consumes its contribution: subtracting one expert changes both the direction of the residual stream and the scale applied to what remains. We propose FN-Prune, a training-free criterion that compares the next RMSNorm outputs before and after subtracting each router-weighted expert contribution, holding original routes and weights fixed. Squared differences are averaged over all calibration tokens in one pass; low-scoring experts are physically deleted at uniform per-layer ratios, and inference reroutes among survivors. At 50% expert removal, FN-Prune achieves lower WikiText-2 perplexity than the best published methods on Qwen3, ERNIE, and OLMoE, including a 32% reduction on OLMoE. At the same

translated_title: FN-Prune：基于有限RMSNorm扰动的免训练专家剪枝
translated_abstract: 专家剪枝可以降低混合专家语言模型的内存占用，但保持模型质量取决于移除哪些专家。基于频率和幅度的分数是孤立地衡量专家，忽视了归一化如何消耗其贡献：减去一个专家会同时改变残差流的方向以及应用于剩余部分的缩放比例。我们提出FN-Prune，一种免训练的准则，它在保持原始路由和权重固定的情况下，比较减去每个路由器加权专家贡献前后的下一次RMSNorm输出。平方差在一次遍历中对所有校准token进行平均；低分专家以统一的每层比例被物理删除，推理时在幸存专家之间重新路由。在移除50%专家的情况下，FN-Prune在Qwen3、ERNIE和OLMoE上实现了比已发表最佳方法更低的WikiText-2困惑度，包括在OLMoE上降低了32%。
tldr: FN-Prune是一种免训练的专家剪枝方法，通过比较减去各专家贡献前后的RMSNorm输出差异来评估专家重要性，在移除50%专家时于Qwen3、ERNIE和OLMoE上超越现有最佳方法，在OLMoE上困惑度降低32%。
en_tdlr: FN-Prune is a training-free expert pruning method that evaluates expert importance by comparing RMSNorm outputs before and after subtracting each expert contribution, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on Qwen3, ERNIE, and OLMoE at 50% expert removal, including a 32% perplexity reduction on OLMoE.
